name: Dor
overview: Dor was a significant town and district in Palestine, noted for its strategic location on the coast. It was conquered during Joshua's campaign to take the land, as indicated by its mention among the northern kings and territories subdued (Joshua 11:2, 12:23). Although geographically situated within the territory of the tribe of Asher, Dor and its surrounding towns were allotted to the tribe of Manasseh, highlighting the complex tribal boundaries and inheritance divisions (Joshua 17:11). However, Judges 1:27 reveals that Manasseh did not fully drive out the inhabitants of Dor, allowing Canaanites to remain in the land, which reflects ongoing challenges in securing the promised inheritance.
